_comment: JoJoJoin locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 24

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in JoJoJoin, played on a 5x5 board with cells numbered 0-24.
On your turn, place your mark on any empty cell, e.g. '[12]'.
YOU WIN by getting FOUR of your marks in a row — four consecutive cells horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
As Player {player_id} you are '{symbol}'; your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} is not a valid cell. Must be between 0 and 24.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their mark ({symbol}) in cell {cell}.
